name: Bellevue
beschreibung: The Hotel Bellevue is located in Neustift im Stubaital in Tirol. It offers hotel-category accommodation with modern rooms. The location is convenient for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. The property has a wellness area with sauna and steam bath. Guests have the option of booking half board with regional dishes. The Stubaier Gletscher is accessible year-round and also offers skiing opportunities in summer. The hotel is suitable for couples and families. Public transportation stops nearby.
